steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: ...Why did you put all these things out?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe, you wouldn't understand! I'm seeking inspiration from them!
You glance at the shooting props all over the floor, feeling a bit tired. The weather in Eastside is a bit gloomy, and thick clouds have gathered. It will probably rain soon.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I feel like inspiration is just ten steps away!
OwO stands around nonchalantly and points at the sky.
Boom!!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Whoaaa!!!
With a clap of thunder, rain begins to drizzle from the sky. Startled by the thunder, OwO remains frozen on the spot with her hands folded.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Why are you standing here? You might catch a cold from getting wet.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: There's a gazebo over there. Go take cover from the rain. I'll come find you after I pack this up.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: All... all right! Th-then, don't take too long!
OwO dashes to the gazebo, her hands hovering over her eyebrows to block the rain.
The gazebo is an old stone structure. Its age is given away by the vines all over it.
But rather than the gazebo itself, what really caught OwO's attention is the person inside resting against the stone pillar.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Wow... How pretty... Are you a fairy?
Either because of the rain or OwO's awed gasps, the person resting inside slowly wakes up, and brushes aside the lake-blue hair in front of her eyes.
It's raining...?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Yeah...
Seems like spring is here.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Yeah...
Hehe... Why do you keep staring at me?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Because you're so pretty! Are you a fairy from heaven?

steps.speaker: Fairy
steps.content: Haha, you're so cute. I am if you think I am.
OwO watches as the fairy picks up an umbrella and shows it to her.

steps.speaker: Fairy
steps.content: To wake from a thousand-year-old dream, and begrudgingly enter the mortal world... I seem to have slept for a long time, from winter till now...

steps.speaker: Fairy
steps.content: Do you know who brought this umbrella to my side?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You were the only one I saw when I got here... So... I don't know who brought you the umbrella...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But don't worry! One of my underlings knows a lot of people. I hear that he even has a lot of files on them! Maybe he can help you find the owner of this umbrella!
steps.female_content: But don't worry! One of my underlings knows a lot of people. I hear that she even has a lot of files on them! Maybe she can help you find the owner of this umbrella!

steps.content: Hands on her hips, OwO proudly tells the fairy this, as if finding that person is a piece of cake for her.

steps.speaker: Fairy
steps.content: Thank you for your kindness, it's okay... no need for the hassle.
The fairy looks at OwO and smiles.
She takes off the hairpin from her bun, puts it together with a piece of folded paper, and hands it to OwO.

steps.speaker: Fairy
steps.content: If fate permits, he and I will meet again. Please help me pass this on.
steps.female_content: If fate permits, she and I will meet again. Please help me pass this on.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh? You want me to pass it on?
Before OwO has a chance to react, the fairy opens up her white umbrella and walks into the rain.
OwO only regains her focus a while later, when someone pats her on the shoulder.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: OwO, what are you looking at? I called you several times, but you ignored me.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Oh my gosh! I-I just met a fairy! She's so beautiful! She should really be the heroine of my film!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But I forgot to get her contact info... Oh, but she gave me these things? And what did she want me to pass on again...
OwO gives you the things in her hands. One is a beautiful lantern-shaped hairpin, and the other is a folded poster.
You open the poster, and see that it shows a photo of Serpent. She is standing gracefully under an umbrella, dressed in a long white gown in traditional Outlander style.

There's also an inscription to one side: Millenarian waiting,
longing only for now... The signature is a little coiling snake that you're all too familiar with.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: What message did she want you to pass on?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I think it was something like... meeting again if fate permits? Ugh, forget about fate! Let's find her for our next movie!

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: OwO...
You squat down and pat OwO on the shoulder.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: It's not completely impossible to find her to be in your movie...

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: But... We might need to get a loan from Quinn's President.
